heard: A Saturn V rocket generated the lightning that struck it. Many assume Apollo 12 hit a random storm. In reality, its metal body and exhaust triggered the bolts. 36 seconds after liftoff, the first bolt struck. All three fuel cells disconnected, flooding the cockpit with warning lights. A second strike at 52 seconds turned telemetry into gibberish. Fortunately, the rocket's independent guidance system kept flying true. Flight controller John Aaron called out a switch from an earlier test. Astronaut Alan and being flipped it, restoring telemetry instantly. The mission survived lightning of its own making.
differences: 'bean' heard as 'and being' after 'test astronaut alan'
